record.paper_title: Solutions to two open problems in topological residuated lattices
record.context_brief: Cardinality of filter topologies versus linear topological residuated lattices
record.original_question: Let L be a residuated lattice and let F(L) be the set of all filters of L. For each filter F, define T_F = {U subseteq L : for every x in U, x/F is contained in U}; this construction makes (L, T_F) a linear Alexandrov topological residuated lattice, and distinct filters produce distinct topologies, so there is an injective map from F(L) to LTRL(L), where LTRL(L) denotes the set of all linear topological residuated lattices whose underlying set is L. Are the sets F(L) and LTRL(L) equipotent?

evidence.quote: whether the sets $\mathcal{F}(L)$ and $LTRL(L)$ are equipotent?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(L,\wedge,\vee,\odot,\to,0,1)$ be a residuated lattice; that is, $(L,\wedge,\vee,0,1)$ is a bounded lattice, $(L,\odot,1)$ is a commutative monoid, and $\odot,\to$ form an adjoint pair: $x\odot y \le z$ iff $x\le y\to z$. A filter of $L$ is a nonempty subset $F\subseteq L$ that is upward closed under $\le$ and closed under $\odot$. Let $\mathcal F(L)$ denote the set of all filters of $L$. For each filter $F$, define the equivalence class $x/F=\{y\in L:(x\to y)\odot(y\to x)\in F\}$, and set 
$$\mathcal T_F=\{U\subseteq L:\text{for every }x\in U,\ x/F\subseteq U\}.$$
Then $(L,\mathcal T_F)$ is an Alexandrov topological residuated lattice (i.e., the lattice operations, $\odot$ and $\to$ are continuous, and arbitrary intersections of opens are open) which is moreover linear, meaning the topology is closed under arbitrary unions and intersections in the relevant sense for the algebraic operations. Distinct filters yield distinct topologies, so $F\mapsto\mathcal T_F$ is an injection from $\mathcal F(L)$ into $\mathrm{LTRL}(L)$, the set of all linear topological residuated lattice structures on the underlying set $L$.

Question: For every residuated lattice $L$, is $|\mathcal F(L)|=|\mathrm{LTRL}(L)|$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question was posed as one of two open problems in earlier work on topological residuated lattices and was addressed by He, Yang, and Wang in "Solutions to two open problems in topological residuated lattices" (Fuzzy Sets and Systems, 2021), which provides resolutions to both problems concerning the relationship between filters and linear topological residuated lattices.

status_evidence.snippet: Discusses the result |F(L)| = |ZLTRL(L)| and subsequent corrections related to linear topological residuated lattices.
